profile.legalName: Service Employees International Union - 1021 Ohlone Chapter
profile.summary: SEIU 1021 is a labor union that represents workers in Northern California, including employees of local governments, nonprofit agencies, health care programs and schools. It negotiates contracts and provides union representation, benefits, training and advocacy for its members. It is part of the Service Employees International Union.
